audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart says Shen/Skill at Level 3, Levels 4-5, Level 6 and Shen at First item; the packet chart and the already-audited K'Sante mirror both give K'Sante levels 3, 4-5 and 6, and Skill at first item.
audit.why: Both directions must agree. K'Sante's Path Maker (W, 14/13/12/11/10s) charges to take reduced damage and eats the Shadow Dash burst, and All Out (R) wins the local duel at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4-5 and 6 flip to K'Sante at 4/10 (inverse of the mirror's 6/10); First item flips to Skill; Level 1, Level 2 and 2+ items unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and spikes[3] describe the spikes vaguely and omit real cooldowns and the Stand United channel cancel.
audit.why: Path Maker is a 12s cooldown at rank 3; All Out is 120/100/80s. Ntofo Strikes and Path Maker both interrupt Shen's Stand United channel.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now names Path Maker with its 12s cooldown; spikes[3] states the channel cancel and the condition for starting R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly claims Spirit's Refuge blocks K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes (Q) poke. Riot's text blocks ATTACKS only; abilities pass through. Also missing: Path Maker's true damage defeats stacked armour, and Q/W cancel Stand United.
audit.why: Riot ability text for Spirit's Refuge — 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Path Maker carries trueDamage; both Q and W are hard CC that interrupt a channel.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1], whys[2], whys[3], spikes[1], spikes[3] and dontsFull[2] rewritten to state attack-only blocking, the true-damage/armour point, and the channel cancel.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged "All Out's" in whys[5] as a probable wrong ability name. It is the real name of K'Sante's R — false positive, left alone.

edits.before: K'Sante's full kit lets him W-tank your taunt and punish the commit — he controls trade timing here if you over-extend on a shielded all-in.
edits.after: Path Maker (W) charges to take reduced damage, so he absorbs your taunt burst and Footwork (E) shields the rest — he sets the trade timing at Level 3.

edits.before: His Q corridor and W-into-trade patterns are at their best value; respect his range advantage and only commit when W is confirmed spent.
edits.after: K'Sante owns these levels: Path Maker (W) tanks your Shadow Dash burst on a 12s cooldown, so only commit once you have watched him spend it.

edits.before: All Out is live and he becomes a threat-duelist — but Stand United is also live, so even conceding the local lane is fine. R away and impact another fight the moment he burns All Out.
edits.after: All Out walls you off, heals him and drops his resists — he wins the local 1v1 now. Stand United answers it: concede the lane and R to a fight elsewhere while his 120s ultimate is spent.

edits.before: K'Sante's W charge and Q poke corridor reach their early peak; he can W-tank your taunt and start controlling the wave if you over-commit.
edits.after: Path Maker (W) peaks on a 12s cooldown — he charges through your taunt burst and Ntofo Strikes (Q) pulls you in, so give nothing until W is spent.

edits.before: Your Sunfire/Hollow Radiance tank power and global R frequency far outpace K'Sante's carry threat; his All Out fighter window is real but your teamfight impact decides the map.
edits.after: Your tank stats and Stand United uptime outpace his All Out duel window — but Ntofo Strikes (Q) and Path Maker (W) both cancel the channel, so start R only after his CC is spent.

edits.before: W-block his Q corridor poke on the all-in to force Ki Barrier and out-trade the exchange
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks his autos, not Ntofo Strikes — cast through it and eat only the Q

edits.before: K'Sante wastes All Out — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Two hits fire a shockwave that pulls you in — step off the line.

edits.before: Tunneling the 1v1 while your R could flip a dive bot — Shen who only plays his lane is half a champion.
edits.after: Path Maker charges reduced damage and its hit is true damage — armour is no answer; wait out its 12s cooldown.

notes: Chart rows 3/4-5/6/first-item flipped as one atomic group in both layers to match the packet chart and the audited K'Sante mirror. suspectNames flagged "All Out's" in whys[5] — false positive, All Out is the real R name. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only; every 'W-block his Q' claim in this matchup was wrong and is corrected where the length band allowed. breakdown.early/mid and the long early/mid/late prose still carry the same 'W-block his Q poke' framing but are too long to rewrite inside the band without losing content — flagged for a later pass.
